title: grammitis ceylanica
intro: Grammitis ceylanica, commonly known as Ceylonese Grammitis or Ceylon Fern, is a species of epiphytic fern native to Sri Lanka. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Grammitis ceylanica are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
